$comment: Constructed from OpenTelemetry Semantic Conventions 1.44 concepts; see ../provenance.json.

dur_ms.description: Elapsed operation duration measured in milliseconds.

err_type.description: Class of error that ended the operation, or an HTTP status code string.

http_mthd.description: HTTP method used for the request.

peer_addr.description: Network address of the directly connected peer.

resp_code.description: HTTP response status code returned by the server.

server_addr.description: Logical server host name or address for the request.

span_uid.description: Identifier of this individual operation span.

svc_nm.description: Logical name of the service producing the telemetry.

trace_uid.description: Identifier shared by all spans in the distributed trace.

url_full.description: Absolute URL requested by the client.
